actions.action: Inspect roots for firmness, color and sour smell
Trim all black/mushy roots and stem sections, cut above healthy node, sterilizing scissors between cuts
Rinse the cutting and scrub the bottle or mug clean
Do a full water change with fresh room-temperature water every 3 to 5 days
Move plant to bright, indirect light
Once new roots are a few cm long, pot in well-draining mix or LECA and keep lightly moist
If rot returns, reassess container or light

reason: The answer correctly identifies root rot from topping off and gives the key fixes (trim rotten roots, rinse, full water changes), but it misses the small-container and fertilizer parts and even says nothing needs adding to the water, which is incomplete but not likely to worsen the plant.
